description_html:
The Aspire Nautilus 2S Coil is a replacement coil for compatible Aspire devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: 0.4Ω / 0.7Ω Mesh
  • Coil Material: Mesh (0.7Ω) / BVC (0.4Ω)
  • Compatible Devices: Aspire Nautilus 2S, Nautilus 3 / 3S / 3SR, Nautilus GT II (0.7Ω Mesh also fits Nautilus Nano)
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: Aspire

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: MESH 0.7OHM, 0.4ohm.
